_comment: Acknowledged formula disagreements, written by `scripts/check_formula_agreement.py --update-baseline`. The check fails on any disagreement not listed here or whose variants have changed, and on entries that are no longer in disagreement. Resolve groups by editing the records, then rerun with --update-baseline to drop them; never add to this file by hand to silence a finding.
